Daintree Accommodation
More than a place to stay. A place to connect.
Noah Creek ECO-RETREAT
& PRIVATE Rainforest Trail Reserve
Nestled in the heart of the world-renowned Daintree Cape Tribulation rainforest, Noah Creek is a private World Heritage Rainforest Reserve.
Offering exclusive hiking access to graded walking trails through Noah Valley and eco-friendly lodge, hut and glamping accommodations, it’s the largest private rainforest reserve in the area. Noah Creek provides a secluded, minimal-impact experience. Access is by booking only to preserve its pristine environment.

Daintree Eco Hut & Glamping Accommodation | Noah Creek
DAINTREE ECO-HUTS ACCOMMODATION
nature TRAILS at your door
Experience glamping in the heart of Noah Creek Rainforest Reserve. Choose private Eco-Huts with bathrooms or cozy tents with shared facilities. Enjoy trails, freshwater swimming holes, and a true rainforest escape. Perfect for nature retreats, hiking enthusiasts, and families or groups seeking privacy and exclusivity.
The Lodge House
Sleeps up to 8 Guests
The Lodge features glass sliding doors, a large loft bunk room, and access to the reserve’s private rainforest trails.
View Room Book Now

ACCOMMODATION FEATURES
Huts are cleaned prior to use and water, fridge, hot water and solar power will be turned on. Linen is provided.
Features Include:
Kitchen with fridge and stove (shared for eco-hut and glamping option)
Esky for refreshments
Tea, coffee, sugar
12 volt lighting, USB charge points.
Modern toilet, shower / bath
Gas hot water
Gas BBQ
Outdoor dining area
What to bring:
Food provisions & drinks (or eat out in a local restaurant)
Insect repellent (personal preference)
Drinking water (uv-sterilised water provide)
Joggers and / or boots (one pair for wet walking)
Head torch (needed for night time reading etc.)
Rain jacket or umbrella
Hiking First Aid kit
Swimwear & Beach Towel
Hat and Sunscreen
Sense of Adventure

Optional Extras & Services
Noah s offers plenty to do on the Reserve. We also offer tour booking services and can pass on our recommendations of what is best to see and do in the area.

We can offer basic fishing gear. Please check with reception to see what is available. We can also arrange massages & yoga sessions.
Hut Extras
We can also provide you with:
Wi-Fi / Phone access

See the Reserve Reception for prices and to arrange.
Tree House BBQ Luncheons
The River House and Rainforest Picnic Huts can be pre-booked for functions.
Please  contact us for more information regarding requirements or for exclusive private bookings of the reserve’s accommodation and function venues.
Booking Desk
Tour Bookings can be arranged via the Reserve Reception.

How to Find Us — Thornton Beach, Daintree | Noah Creek
NOAH CREEK RAINFOREST RESERVE
In the heart of the Daintree Rainforest
The Noah Valley Rainforest Reserve is located in the heart of the Daintree, just 20 km north of the Daintree Ferry. We re about 2 hours drive from Cairns and 1 hour from Port Douglas—perfectly positioned to tour Cape Tribulation.
Head North
Travel north from Cairns and Port Douglas, through the township of Mossman. You will need to take the Daintree Ferry, which operates 5am to midnight, 7 days a week and is well sign-posted for your convenience.
Once you have crossed the Daintree River on the ferry, it’s a scenic drive 20km north, which will take you over the Alexandra Range and into the Daintree Rainforest and Cape Tribulation, where the rainforest meets the reef.
Almost there!
Once you have spotted the coast, you are at the small village of Thornton Beach. The Noah Creek Rainforest Reserve commences just north of here. Watch out for speed bumps and cassowary crossings.
You will need to make your way to the Reserve’s head quarters / Reception Office to check-in. The Reception Office is located on the left immediately before the Noah Creek Bridge. 20km North of the ferry.
Time to go off road!
Off road access to the reserve accommodation is via dirt track. 2WD vehicles are generally acceptable, drivers take care and drive to conditions as access can degrade over the wet. Low clearance or over size vehicles may need to be left near the beginning of the track or at reception. Guests can arrange for the Reserve staff to lend assistance by ferrying in luggage.
Please let us know of expected arrival time following booking.
